rules.label: Uninsured medical expenses
rules.receiptDeadlineQuote: The Purchasing Parent shall give the Other Parent a copy of the receipt within thirty (30) days of the purchase.
rules.reimburseQuote: The Other Parent shall reimburse the Purchasing Parent for their share within thirty (30) days of receiving the receipt.
rules.quote: Uninsured medical, dental and vision expenses for the Child shall be shared equally (50/50) by the Parents.
